scope: Cooperative x86 TCG task-private RAM pages and instruction-fetch overlays, selected by a stable monitor anchor and guest doorbell; scoped to a stopped single-vCPU QMP control surface.

qmp_commands.name: x-fdisbull-task-monitor-init
qmp_commands.purpose: Register the private RAM arena and migration state; prepare-only keeps a fresh destination disabled until VMState restore.

qmp_commands.name: x-fdisbull-task-register
qmp_commands.purpose: Register/extend a task lifetime and clone direct RAM pages into private backing.

qmp_commands.name: x-fdisbull-task-layer-configure
qmp_commands.purpose: Apply guarded private data writes and complete fetch-overlay configuration.

qmp_commands.name: x-fdisbull-task-layer-read
qmp_commands.purpose: Read an explicit task-private RAM, effective fetch, or shared base view.

qmp_commands.name: x-fdisbull-task-layer-observe
qmp_commands.purpose: Read registry, selection, generations, page digests and overlay digests without mutation.

qmp_commands.name: x-fdisbull-task-retire
qmp_commands.purpose: Tombstone an incarnation and revoke its active CPU view.

layout: scheduler sequence (uint64 LE; even when stable)
switch_protocol.doorbell: OUTW 0xF1DB, 0x4446 after publishing the new stable even anchor sequence
switch_protocol.selection: Initial stable registered anchor may select the first task; later selection changes only after a valid increasing even sequence and a doorbell at a TCG block boundary, before a stopped single-step result is exposed.

migration.state: Task registry, page-slot assignments, fetch overlays, selected task and epoch/generation highwaters; private arena RAM travels as a RAMBlock. Destination QMP prepare-only initialization must occur before snapshot load.

build_receipt.build: Incremental Ninja build completed successfully; no CI run by patch author.

runtime_evidence.current_candidate: 899 broader local checks passed with zero failures or skips on the exact binary. Includes ten authored task-private cases: two five-visit cold-process restore profiles, retirement/invalid commits/atomic admission, two dormant-task protected/V86 restores, single-step plus selected-B restore, and reset revocation.
runtime_evidence.broader_regression: task-private-regression-01: 899 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped; further final admission-guard and documentation contracts recorded in the private verification receipt.
runtime_evidence.limitations: Bounded cooperating-monitor witnesses, not QEMM/DESQview vendor compatibility or a full DOS scheduler qualification.

limitations: Only x86 system TCG is implemented; no non-x86 QMP stubs are supplied for multi-target builds.
Requires one vCPU; mutating and observation QMP commands require a stopped single-vCPU x86 TCG machine.
Task selection is cooperative: a monitor must publish FDBTASK1 and issue the OUTW doorbell. QEMU does not identify or schedule proprietary QEMM/DESQview tasks.
At most 16 task lifetimes and 16 4-KiB direct-RAM pages per task; one 1-MiB native arena.
Direct writable RAM only. Active legacy non-PAE page directory and page-table pages cannot be private; PAE paging is rejected while private pages are active.

Device memory, ROM/ROMD, discard-managed memory, DMA/IOMMU views, and device-side access to task-private RAM are unsupported. Devices and GDB physical memory use shared base RAM; use explicit QMP task-layer-read views for task-private inspection.
No claim is made about private DMA, other accelerators, multiple vCPUs, or arbitrary guest schedulers.
Guest self-modification of a configured fetch backing or mismatch of guarded expected bytes revokes the view and stops before stale overlay execution.
Task-private VMState is version 1 and is separate from the host controller sidecar.
